from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class CompanyFinancialMetrics(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics extracted from a single company's Q1 2025 report."""
    document_id: Optional[int] = Field(description="Document index in the input collection")
    company_name: Optional[str] = Field(description="Full name of the company")
    stock_code: Optional[str] = Field(description="Stock/Security code of the company")
    reporting_period: Optional[str] = Field(description="Reporting period, expected '2025-Q1'")
    
    # Income Statement Items
    net_profit: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net Profit Attributable to Shareholders")
    operating_revenue: Optional[float] = Field(description="Operating Revenue")
    
    # Cash Flow Statement Items
    operating_cash_flow: Optional[float] = Field(description="Net Operating Cash Flow")
    
    # Balance Sheet Items
    total_assets: Optional[float] = Field(description="Total Assets")
    monetary_funds: Optional[float] = Field(description="Monetary Funds")
    accounts_receivable: Optional[float] = Field(description="Accounts Receivable")
    inventory: Optional[float] = Field(description="Inventory")
    accounts_payable: Optional[float] = Field(description="Accounts Payable")
    contract_liabilities: Optional[float] = Field(description="Contract Liabilities")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_reports: List[CompanyFinancialMetrics]
